jury.remarks: The color palette is unified but lacks contrast between materials. The silhouette is balanced but the fabric transitions are visually flat.
The dress conveys a serious, elegant mood through its structured form and muted tones, but lacks a distinctive expressive element.
The combination of wool and tweed is conventional; the design lacks boldness or unconventional juxtapositions to qualify as avant-garde.
The proportions are well-defined with a natural waist and fitted skirt. The seam lines and paneling suggest a clean, structured construction.

limitations: Only visible garment and supplied material facts; hidden views, real construction, originality across other dresses and unsupported editor actions are unknown.
